SkyPath Platform
Real-Time Turbulence Monitoring from Multiple Data Sources

SkyPath is a crowdsourced app that provides pilots with notifications about upcoming turbulence along their flight route. It delivers visible and audible alerts before turbulence is encountered, along with a view of the surrounding airspace turbulence map. This allows pilots to take proactive measures, such as ensuring passengers and crew are seated and buckled or adjusting altitude to avoid turbulence.

SkyPath delivers a proactive, data-driven approach to managing and mitigating turbulence. In today’s environment, it’s no longer optional – it’s essential.

How the magic happens

SkyPath doesn’t just optimize safety - it transforms the entire flight experience. 

Book a demo
Start a trial

01

Comprehensive Turbulence Sensing with Multi-Source Data Collection 

SkyPath provides Turbulence data from five different sources. Each data source undergoes advanced calculations, AI modeling, filtering, and normalization to ensure accuracy and reliability. Turbulence data is then seamlessly distributed across the entire SkyPath ecosystem.

02

AI-Driven OneLayer capability: Consolidated Data Engine for Operational Clarity 

SkyPath OneLayer is a smart, consolidated ride quality layer that combines top turbulence data sources into a single, intuitive display, enhancing pilots’ situational awareness and reducing workload. OneLayer cleans, unifies, and contextualizes all SkyPath multi-source data through AI, filtering noise and standardizing for consistent reliability across aircraft and operations. 

03

Real-Time Notifications and Ecosystem-Wide Distribution 

Timely, de-cluttered turbulence notifications are delivered to pilots, dispatchers, and ops teams, empowering safer, more informed decisions at every phase of flight.

Optimized Budget

By reducing turbulence-related injuries, optimizing fuel usage, and reducing maintenance and unplanned inspection aspects, SkyPath helps operators save significantly, boosting bottom line. 

Efficient Maintenance 

SkyPath helps operators in lowering maintenance costs by offering predictive insights into turbulence-related wear and tear, enabling a proactive approach toward reducing unplanned inspections and ensuring smoother operations.

Improved Safety

Using real-time turbulence observations and predictions, SkyPath allows pilots to adjust flight paths in advance, reducing the risk of injury and improving safety for passengers and crew.

Fuel Consumption

SkyPath’s precise data for optimized routes helps pilots avoid unnecessary turbulence, reducing fuel consumption and improving fleet operational efficiency.
